title: Townsend Brown workbooks posted online

tellings.quote: somebody just posted on the internet the workbooks Thompson from

plain: In 2025 someone posted on the internet the workbooks of Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor whose experiments are tied in this field to ideas about how UFOs might fly. Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, mentions it to Michels in passing, saying "somebody just posted on the internet the workbooks," without saying who. If the workbooks are genuine, Brown's own notes would now be open for anyone to read.
